Name: TC_TIME_003 (security): Prevent unauthorized access to other employees' timesheets via URL manipulation (IDOR)
Precondition:
PRE-CONDITIONS
1. Stable internet connection
2. Use one of the following environments:
* Windows 11 / Google Chrome v149 / 1920x1080 / v5.8
* Linux 7.0 / Google Chrome v149 / 1920x1080 / v5.8
3. Navigate to URL: https://opensource-demo.orangehrmlive.com
4. For the Employee usage
* Follow the TC: TC_PIM_001 (Positive): Add a new employee with valid
mandatory data
* Login with the Employee credentials made
5. Go to the module: TIME
REQUIREMENTS
TC_AUTH_Login_004(Positive): Verify sucessfull login with valid admin
credentials.

Verify that an employee cannot view or modify another employee's timesheet
by changing the timesheet ID or employee ID parameter directly in the URL.
Step: On the login page, log in with the newly created Employee credentials.
Expected Result: Authentication is successful. The Dashboard is displayed without errors.
